claims.summary: The V0.16.89 production package passed its content/export contract but still used two cached-Gemma calls for explicit structure restatement and a sampled voice rewrite.

A strict exact-count, explicitly named lesson sequence compiles into the typed native skeleton before the browser model runtime or storage boundary; its provisional workspace title remains exact from the first build frame, while ambiguous briefs retain Gemma.
The explicit structure and exact evidence routes compose without model activation, and the sampled voice pass cannot reactivate the model on that complete route.
Compiler projections no longer synthesize model token usage, count as provider requests, or overwrite Scion execution as local Gemma.

The exact local Digital Accessibility replay preserved the measured package results with zero provider starts and a valid physical export; its timing is not represented as a matched cold-network benchmark.
Scion adopts progressive verified capability routing from the Kimi review without importing Kimi weights, hidden reasoning, MoE topology, or protocol.
V0.16.90 changes routing, voice-pass admission, and telemetry while leaving weights, adapter state, evidence admission, consent, and the readiness ceiling unchanged; V30 inherits no result.
